requirements.title: Procedure pointers are procedures with the POINTER attribute
requirements.definition: A procedure pointer is a procedure that has the POINTER attribute.

pending.procedure-pointer-has-pointer-attribute: Declare PROCEDURE(integer_fun), POINTER :: p; associate p with module function answer returning 42, initialize result to -8, call p(), and expect 42.

requirements.title: Procedure pointers can associate with external, internal, intrinsic, or module procedures
requirements.definition: A procedure pointer can be pointer associated with an external, internal, intrinsic, or module procedure.

pending.procedure-pointer-associated-external: Associate procedure pointer p with external function ext_answer returning 42; call p() after result sentinel -8 and expect 42.
pending.procedure-pointer-associated-internal: Inside a host, associate procedure pointer p with internal function answer using host integer 40; call p() and expect 42.
pending.procedure-pointer-associated-intrinsic: Default companion associates a compatible procedure pointer with intrinsic ABS and calls it with -42; result sentinel -777 becomes 42. Wrong-resolution sentinel companion associates the pointer with user function abs returning -999, making accidental non-intrinsic association observable.
pending.procedure-pointer-associated-module: Associate procedure pointer p with module function answer returning 42; call p() and expect 42 from sentinel -777. Wrong-resolution sentinel companion associates p with external answer returning -999, making the selected target class observable.
